tasks.name: Release
tasks.prompt: Release a new Headway version. Steps, in order: (1) Run the test suite (make test) and stop if anything fails. (2) Decide the next semver version (patch unless told otherwise). (3) Write release notes for everything since the last tag (git log <last-tag>..HEAD, plus uncommitted changes) as a new `## <version> — <YYYY-MM-DD>` section at the top of CHANGELOG.md, above the previous version. Use short sections (New / Improved / Fixed as needed) with bullets; each notable change gets bold text for its title followed by a short, impactful description and use case, e.g. `- **Jira Cloud sync**: link a plan to a Jira project so features push to issues and status flows back.` Skip internal-only chores. (4) Bump the version in package.json, package-lock.json, and src-tauri/Cargo.toml (and Cargo.lock's headway entry) to match. (5) Commit, create the tag v<version>, and push the commit and the tag. The release workflow builds the installers and publishes the GitHub release using the CHANGELOG.md section as its body; the app shows the same notes after updating.
